import gzip, scipy.io, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
mat = scipy.io.mmread('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr().astype(float)
feat = pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz', sep='\\t', header=None, names=['id','name','type'])
bc = pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz', sep='\\t', header=None, names=['barcode'])
calls = pd.read_csv('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv')
ref = pd.read_csv('feature_reference.csv')
guide_to_gene = dict(zip(ref.id, ref.target_gene_name))
# align calls to matrix columns
bc['pos']=np.arange(len(bc))
calls = calls.merge(bc, left_on='cell_barcode', right_on='barcode', how='inner')
print('overlap', len(calls))
# cell stats
totals = np.asarray(mat.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
nfeatures = np.asarray((mat>0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
path_genes_idx = list(range(20))
path_counts = np.asarray(mat[path_genes_idx,:].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
# log normalize
# CPM log1p
cpm = mat.multiply(1.0/totals).tocsr() * 10000
logcpm = cpm.copy(); logcpm.data = np.log1p(logcpm.data)
path_logmean = np.asarray(logcpm[path_genes_idx,:].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
# first 20 mean, maybe pathway score
calls['total'] = totals[calls.pos.values]
calls['nfeatures'] = nfeatures[calls.pos.values]
calls['path_counts'] = path_counts[calls.pos.values]
calls['path_prop'] = path_counts/np.maximum(totals,1)
calls['path_logmean'] = path_logmean[calls.pos.values]
calls['gene'] = calls.feature_call.map(guide_to_gene)
print(calls.groupby('gene').size().to_string())
# Compare each guide to NT for path_logmean, path_prop, path_counts
nt = calls[calls.gene=='Non-Targeting']
print('NT stats', nt[['total','path_counts','path_prop','path_logmean']].describe().T.to_string())
rows=[]
for g,grp in calls.groupby('feature_call'):
    gene=grp.gene.iloc[0]
    if g in nt.feature_call.unique(): # non target guide? don't compare self? maybe all NT pooled
        continue
    # Welch t test
    for metric in ['path_logmean','path_prop','path_counts','total']:
        a=grp[metric].values; b=nt[metric].values
        t,p=ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=False)
        # cohen's d using pooled
        sd=np.sqrt(((len(a)-1)*a.var(ddof=1)+(len(b)-1)*b.var(ddof=1))/(len(a)+len(b)-2))
        d=(a.mean()-b.mean())/sd if sd>0 else np.nan
        rows.append(dict(feature_call=g, gene=gene, n=len(a), metric=metric, mean=a.mean(), nt_mean=b.mean(), diff=a.mean()-b.mean(), p=p, d=d))
res=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# pivot d and p for path_logmean
piv=res[res.metric=='path_logmean'].set_index('gene')[['n','mean','nt_mean','diff','d','p']].sort_values('diff')
print('\\nRanked by path_logmean diff vs NT (all):')
print(piv.to_string())
# robust use Mann Whitney maybe
print('\\nTop by d negative:')
print(piv.sort_values('d').head(20).to_string())
# total maybe
print('\\nTotal counts diff')
print(res[res.metric=='total'].set_index('gene')[['n','mean','nt_mean','diff','d','p']].sort_values('diff').head(20).to_string())
PY"

import scipy.io, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
mat = scipy.io.mmread('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr().astype(float)
feat = pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz', sep='\\t', header=None, names=['id','name','type'])
bc = pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz', sep='\\t', header=None, names=['barcode'])
calls = pd.read_csv('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv')
ref = pd.read_csv('feature_reference.csv')
guide_to_gene=dict(zip(ref.id,ref.target_gene_name)); guide_to_name=dict(zip(ref.id,ref.name))
bc['pos']=np.arange(len(bc))
calls=calls.merge(bc,left_on='cell_barcode',right_on='barcode')
totals=np.asarray(mat.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
cpm = mat.multiply(1.0/totals).tocsr()*10000
logcpm=cpm.copy(); logcpm.data=np.log1p(logcpm.data)
nt=calls[calls.feature_call.str.startswith('guide_00')] # guides 1-10? actually 001-010 non-targeting
# nt includes guide_001-010; gene Non-Targeting
path_genes=feat['name'][:20].tolist()
nt_mean=np.asarray(logcpm[:20,:][:,nt.pos.values].mean(axis=1)).ravel()
print('NT mean for 20 genes:')
for i,g in enumerate(path_genes): print(g, round(nt_mean[i],3))
# for select guides, print mean logcpm per gene and diff vs NT
for guide in ['guide_011','guide_012','guide_019','guide_035','guide_029']:
    grp=calls[calls.feature_call==guide]
    m=np.asarray(logcpm[:20,:][:,grp.pos.values].mean(axis=1)).ravel()
    print('\\n', guide, guide_to_gene[guide], 'n',len(grp),'path mean',round(m.mean(),3))
    for i,g in enumerate(path_genes):
        diff=m[i]-nt_mean[i]
        if abs(diff)>0.2 or guide in ['guide_011','guide_012']:
            print(f'{g:8s} nt={nt_mean[i]:6.3f} grp={m[i]:6.3f} diff={diff:7.3f}')
# compute pathway score excluding each guide's target gene if target in first20, and rank
rows=[]
for guide, grp in calls.groupby('feature_call'):
    gene=guide_to_gene[guide]
    if gene=='Non-Targeting': continue
    # exclude target gene from signature if among first20
    idx=[i for i,g in enumerate(path_genes) if g"'!=gene]
    m=np.asarray(logcpm[idx,:][:,grp.pos.values].mean(axis=1)).ravel()
    nm=nt_mean[np.array(idx)]
    # actually nt_mean already per gene; compute nt cell values
    ntv=np.asarray(logcpm[idx,:][:,nt.pos.values].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    t,p=ttest_ind(m,ntv,equal_var=False)
    sd=np.sqrt(((len(m)-1)*m.var(ddof=1)+(len(ntv)-1)*ntv.var(ddof=1))/(len(m)+len(ntv)-2))
    d=(m.mean()-ntv.mean())/sd
    rows.append(dict(gene=gene,n=len(m),mean=m.mean(),nt_mean=ntv.mean(),diff=m.mean()-ntv.mean(),d=d,p=p))
res=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('"'gene').sort_values('diff')
print('\\nRank by pathway logmean excluding own target:')
print(res.to_string())

import scipy.io, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
mat=scipy.io.mmread('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr().astype(float)
feat=pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',header=None,names=['id','name','type'])
bc=pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',header=None,names=['barcode'])
calls=pd.read_csv('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv')
ref=pd.read_csv('feature_reference.csv'); g2g=dict(zip(ref.id,ref.target_gene_name))
bc['pos']=np.arange(len(bc)); calls=calls.merge(bc,left_on='cell_barcode',right_on='barcode')
totals=np.asarray(mat.sum(axis=0)).ravel(); cpm=mat.multiply(1.0/totals).tocsr()*10000
logcpm=cpm.copy(); logcpm.data=np.log1p(logcpm.data)
# scale path genes across cells to z scores; PCA
X=logcpm[:20,:].toarray().T
X=(X-X.mean(axis=0))/X.std(axis=0)
pca=PCA(n_components=5, random_state=0).fit(X)
print('explained variance ratio', pca.explained_variance_ratio_)
print('PC1 loadings top:')
for i,g in enumerate(feat['name'][:20]):
    print(g, round(pca.components_[0,i],3))
pc1=pca.transform(X)[:,0]
nt=calls[calls.feature_call.str.startswith('guide_00')]
ntpc=pc1[nt.pos.values]
for guide in ['guide_011','guide_012','guide_019']:
    grp=calls[calls.feature_call==guide]
    a=pc1[grp.pos.values]
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,ntpc)
    print(guide,g2g[guide],a.mean(),np.median(a),a.std(),p)
# print top guides by pc1 mean
rows=[]
for guide,grp in calls.groupby('feature_call'):
    gene=g2g[guide]
    if gene=='Non-Targeting': continue
    a=pc1[grp.pos.values]
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,ntpc)
    rows.append((gene,len(a),a.mean(),a.median(),p))
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['gene','n','mean','median','p']).sort_values('mean').head(10).to_string(index=False))
PY"

import scipy.io, numpy as np, pandas as pd, statsmodels.api as sm
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
mat=scipy.io.mmread('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr().astype(float)
feat=pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',header=None,names=['id','name','type'])
bc=pd.read_csv('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',header=None,names=['barcode'])
calls=pd.read_csv('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv')
ref=pd.read_csv('feature_reference.csv'); g2g=dict(zip(ref.id,ref.target_gene_name))
bc['pos']=np.arange(len(bc)); calls=calls.merge(bc,left_on='cell_barcode',right_on='barcode')
totals=np.asarray(mat.sum(axis=0)).ravel(); path_counts=np.asarray(mat[:20,:].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
calls['path_counts']=path_counts[calls.pos.values]; calls['total']=totals[calls.pos.values]
# create factor target, with NT baseline
calls['pert']=calls.feature_call.map(g2g)
# For each gene target vs NT separately using NB? statsmodels GLM negative binomial maybe.
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
rows=[]
nt=calls[calls.pert=='Non-Targeting']
for gene,grp in calls[calls.pert"'!='"'Non-Targeting'].groupby('pert'):
    sub=pd.concat([nt,grp])
    X=sm.add_constant((sub.pert==gene).astype(float))
    # negative binomial GLM with log total offset
    try:
        mod=sm.GLM(sub.path_counts, X, family=sm.families.NegativeBinomial(), offset=np.log(sub.total))
        res=mod.fit()
        p=res.pvalues.iloc[1]
        coef=res.params.iloc[1]
        rows.append(dict(gene=gene,n=len(grp),coef=coef,p=p))
    except Exception as e:
        rows.append(dict(gene=gene,n=len(grp),coef=np.nan,p=np.nan,err=str(e)))
res=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('p')
res['fdr']=sm.stats.multipletests(res.p, method='fdr_bh')[1]
print(res.to_string(index=False))
PY"
